description: This PHP source file defines the `Api` class within the `Opencart\Admin\Model\User` namespace, implementing CRUD operations and associated functionalities for API records in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class provides methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving API records, IP addresses, and histories from the database.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Model class for handling API records, IP addresses, and history data in the OpenCart administrative environment. Provides methods for CRUD operations and data retrieval related to APIs.

methods.name: addApi
methods.description: Creates a new API record in the database with provided data and optional associated IP addresses. Returns the ID of the newly created record.

methods.name: editApi
methods.description: Updates an existing API record identified by its ID with new data and replaces associated IP addresses.

methods.name: deleteApi
methods.description: Deletes an API record from the database by its ID and removes its associated IP addresses.

methods.name: getApi
methods.description: Retrieves a specific API record by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getApis
methods.description: Retrieves a list of API records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalApis
methods.description: Returns the total count of API records in the database.

methods.name: addIp
methods.description: Adds a new IP address record associated with a specific API ID.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Deletes all IP addresses associated with a specific API ID.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all IP addresses associated with a specific API ID.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of history records for a specific API ID.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history records for a specific API ID.
